title: AWAM: Active Trajectory-Conditioned View Imagination for Robust Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23396v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid progress in embodied intelligence has enabled increasingly capable robots to follow language instructions and manipulate diverse objects. However, strong results in structured environments do not automatically transfer to open-world conditions, where clutter, occlusion, and changing viewpoints can obscure the spatial relationships required for action. To address this perceptual gap, a virtual active-perception paradigm is introduced. AWAM, an Active World-Action Model actively plans where to observe and imagines what will be seen along the planned trajectory before acting. Task-related virtual camera motion is predicted and used as a structured query into a geometry-conditioned world model, producing a reusable spatial prior for manipulation, which is later compressed into a fixed memory and fused with live observations through cross-attention for diffusion-based action prediction. AWAM achieves competitive success rates with 75.

translated_title: AWAM：面向鲁棒机器人操作的主动轨迹条件视角想象
translated_abstract: 具身智能的快速发展使得机器人能够日益熟练地遵循语言指令并操作多样化物体。然而，在结构化环境中取得的优异成果并不能自动迁移到开放世界场景中——在开放世界中，杂乱、遮挡和不断变化的视角可能掩盖执行动作所需的空间关系。为了弥合这一感知差距，本文提出了一种虚拟主动感知范式。AWAM（主动世界-动作模型，Active World-Action Model）会在行动之前主动规划观察位置，并想象沿规划轨迹将会看到的画面。该模型预测与任务相关的虚拟相机运动，并将其作为结构化查询输入到几何条件化的世界模型中，从而生成可复用的操作空间先验；该先验随后被压缩为固定记忆，并通过交叉注意力与实时观测相融合，用于基于扩散模型的动作预测。AWAM 以 75……的成功率取得了具有竞争力的表现（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出主动世界-动作模型 AWAM，通过主动规划虚拟相机轨迹并利用几何条件化世界模型想象未来观测，生成可复用的空间先验并与实时观测融合，从而在杂乱、遮挡的开放世界中实现更鲁棒的机器人操作。
en_tdlr: AWAM actively plans virtual camera trajectories and imagines future observations via a geometry-conditioned world model, producing a reusable spatial prior fused with live views to enable robust robot manipulation in cluttered, occluded open-world environments.
